body:
Right now we do not have a way to manually set a refinement on the components themselves, however we do have the `configure` widget you can add. In this case the search parameter `numericFilters` would be set to the value, e.g. `numericFilters: ["price>=290","price<=570"]`.

If it needs to be added dynamically, it might be best to use `connectRange` to make a widget which doesn't render, but sets the parameter on initialisation. With either the connectRange solution or with the configure solution; you then need to use `addWidget` and `removeWidget` when your button would be clicked or navigation would be changed.

If any issues happen with the implementation of this, pleas
